name: convotokens
description: Inspect local Claude Code and Codex transcripts to report tokens consumed inside a session.

interface.longDescription: Read local Claude Code and Codex transcripts and report tokens consumed inside a session, including Codex subagent rollouts and Claude model/source breakdowns. No network calls and no dollar estimates.
defaultPrompt: Show my Codex token usage for this session.
Break down this session's usage and turns by main agent and subagents.
Show total token usage across this whole project, not just this session.
Explain how the local token usage was calculated.
